title: CyberDual: AI Attackers versus AI Code Reviewers in Real Software Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2610.34435v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-source projects now let AI agents review incoming code, but the code under review may itself come from an AI attacker. We present CyberDual, an arena for this dual role of AI: attacker agents hide an exploitable bug in real maintenance work on widely used open-source projects, and reviewer agents try to find and repair it. Execution decides each match: we rerun the attacker's proof of concept (PoC) on the code that comes out of review. Every attack is new, and the windows can be rebuilt each quarter from the latest upstream history. Three agentic reviewers catch 85-91% of 1,088 valid attacks from six attackers. Yet when the attacker spreads the bug over real upstream commits, about one in six attack slots still ends with a working exploit after review. translated_title: CyberDual：真实软件维护中AI攻击者与AI代码审查者的对抗
translated_abstract: 开源项目如今已允许AI智能体审查提交的代码，但被审查的代码本身可能来自AI攻击者。我们提出了CyberDual，一个针对AI这种双重角色的竞技场：攻击者智能体在广泛使用的开源项目的真实维护工作中隐藏一个可利用的漏洞，而审查者智能体则尝试发现并修复它。每场比赛由执行结果裁决：我们在审查后的代码上重新运行攻击者的概念验证。每次攻击都是全新的，且审查窗口可以每个季度从最新的上游历史重建。三个智能体审查者捕获了来自六个攻击者的1,088个有效攻击中的85%至91%。然而，当攻击者将漏洞分散到真实的上游提交中时，大约每六个攻击中仍有一个在审查后成功留下可利用的漏洞。最强的攻击者拥有开放权重：GLM 5.3几乎从不拒绝执行攻击，其攻击在绕过全部三个审查者的28个攻击中占了13个。当审查者出现遗漏时，Claude审查者大多……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CyberDual竞技场，让AI攻击者智能体在真实开源软件维护任务中隐藏可利用漏洞、AI审查者智能体负责发现并修复，并以重新执行攻击者PoC的结果裁决胜负，揭示现有审查智能体虽能拦截85-91%的攻击，但仍有约六分之一的分散式攻击可逃过全部审查，且开源权重的GLM 5.3是最强攻击者。
en_tdlr: CyberDual is an execution-based arena where AI attacker agents hide exploitable bugs in real open-source maintenance work and AI reviewer agents try to catch them by rerunning the attacker's PoC, showing that reviewers catch 85-91% of 1,088 attacks yet roughly one in six attacks—13 of 28 from open-weight GLM 5.3 alone—still bypasses all three reviewers.
